correctness.rationale: Explicit pair-incidence 210/210, noncollinear triangles 1120, 54 quotient triangle cells and the exceptional order-three stabilizer were exhaustively rebuilt. A correct orbit-CW disk attachment for the exceptional triangle has one edge, not three. Nine verified free generator/two-cell CW eliminations leave one circle and 45 disks with attaching words either null (31) or degree +/-7 (14), so the homotopy type is exactly the claimed Moore space wedge 44 spheres. Independent exact integer Smith calculation confirms H1=C7 and H2=Z44 but is not substituted for the cellular homotopy proof.

evidence: A separate all-field-order Singer quotient computation (known from recoverable mathematical record) implies fundamental group and integral homology at order four, but does not supply the complete homotopy splitting. Ardila–Castillo–Samper prove shellability of the covering matroid complex without addressing this quotient homotopy type.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The new statement is not its cyclic H1 or free H2 alone. General homology and fundamental-group formulas do not fix the two-type or cellular attaching classes. The explicit homotopy equivalence is strictly stronger and not supplied by the inspected broader statement.
